init-container-seeds-volume.title: An init container that seeds a shared volume
init-container-seeds-volume.brief: Add an init container to an existing Deployment so that nginx starts with content already in its volume.

readiness-probe-exec.title: A readiness probe that runs a command
readiness-probe-exec.brief: Create a Pod that reports Ready only while a marker file exists, with the probe's timing set exactly.

rollout-surge-and-undo.title: Size a rollout, release a bad image, roll back
rollout-surge-and-undo.brief: Set a Deployment's surge and unavailability limits, push an image that never becomes ready, read the history and undo it.

password-env-to-secret.title: Move a password into a Secret
password-env-to-secret.brief: Replace a plain-text environment variable with one read from a Secret, leaving the other variables as they are.

read-only-pod-role.title: A ServiceAccount that can only read Pods
read-only-pod-role.brief: Write a Role for reading Pods and their logs, bind it to a ServiceAccount, and prove with kubectl auth can-i that it can't do more.

ingress-host-rule.title: Route a host name to a Service
ingress-host-rule.brief: Create an Ingress that sends one host to an existing Service, and check it with curl.
